page.overview:
Who is Chocobo's Dungeon 2 characters?

This is a list of characters from Chocobo's Dungeon 2. Chocobo is the main playable character, but Mog, Shiroma, Cid, and Kuz also become playable after the player finishes the main story. They can each explore a dungeon under some new rules.
